devicedata.name: ATV Spike
devicedata.model: Android TV Remote v2 Capability Probe
devicedata.creator: C4 Google TV project

property.name: Device IP
property.description: IP address of the Google TV / Android TV device. Set a DHCP reservation for it.

property.name: Port
property.description: 6467 = pairing port (accepts any self-signed client cert, so it is the right target for a transport test). 6466 = remote control port (requires an already-paired cert).

property.name: TLS Method
property.description: VERIFY_METHOD passed to NetPortOptions. USE sslv23 - it negotiates the highest mutually supported version. The device was measured to require TLS 1.2 minimum (it rejects 1.0 and 1.1 with alert 70), so tlsv1 and tlsv1_1 are known-dead and are listed only to confirm the failure mode. Try tlsv1_2 second if sslv23 fails, though it may not be an accepted value.

property.name: Cert Path Form
property.description: How the CERTIFICATE / PRIVATE_KEY paths are spelled in NetPortOptions. The SDK says these are relative to the .c4z directory, but the cert is generated at runtime into the sandbox - discovering which spelling resolves is a spike goal.

property.name: Last Result
property.description: Summary of the most recent spike step.
